items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: A beautiful show. Two bands, Ben Pollack's band and Don Redmon. And we used to play the show together.

ctx.x: Teagarden stole a lot of things from him. I have to say stole because that's the truth. You know, Teagarden used to come up in Fletcher's band and want to sit in with him and play, you know, just like Benny Goodman used to come up and want to sit in Fletcher's band up in Harlem when he came to town when they was with Ben Pollack, you see.
